verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a dedicated Structured Outputs capability that constrains model responses to a JSON schema so applications can process generated data reliably, which is the core of this story. The evidence is a single summary line, though, with no detail on how strict enforcement is or which models support it. Missing for 10: details on strict-mode and schema-feature coverage, grammar-based constraint support, per-model support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
